pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against opening secondary or tertiary positions on the same asset within a 120-second window to prevent micro-pyramiding into falling or rising volatility knives.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: No order execution authorized unless the Order Book Imbalance ratio exceeds 1.65 and ATR(14) is below the 80th percentile, blocking high-impact news wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing stop activation and partial scaling at +$15.00 floating profit, locking in wins up to +$30.00 while capping drawdowns firmly between $4.00 and $6.00.
